product.name: Current® Model P+ Smart Electric Pizza Oven, 12-Inch, Slate | App Connectivity Monitors Temperature and Custom Cook Times; Compact Indoor/Outdoor Design Heats to 850°F with 8 Modes.
features: UP TO 850°F FOR TRUE PIZZERIA RESULTS: Reaches 850°F to deliver crispy crust, bubbly cheese, and authentic Neapolitan-style pizza in as little as 2 minutes - no gas, no flame, no compromise.

EIGHT SMART COOKING MODES + MANUAL PRECISION: Neapolitan, New York, Thin Crust, Detroit, Frozen, Bake, Sear, and Broil modes remove guesswork. Fine-tune time and temperature for your exact dough, toppings, and preference.
ELECTRIC. PLUG IN. COOK ANYWHERE: Runs on a standard 120V outlet. Safe for indoor or outdoor use — ideal for kitchens, patios, apartments, condos, and HOA-restricted spaces.

SMART APP CONNECTIVITY: Control your bake from your phone with the CURRENT app and Pizza Build Calculator. Monitor temperature, adjust settings, and receive notifications from your phone. Real-time control without hovering over the oven.
DUAL-PANE WINDOW + TOP HEAT ELEMENT: Watch your crust rise and cheese bubble without opening the door. Engineered for even browning and consistent high-heat performance.
